purpose: Belltower window-box and balcony foliage texture atlas
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a production game foliage texture atlas for window boxes and balconies in a Mediterranean hill-town map. Generate one square 2048x2048 RGBA image with a truly transparent background, arranged as four strictly separated equal square cells in a 2-by-2 layout. No visible grid, borders, labels or text. Top-left cell: one compact red zonal geranium plant (Pelargonium), with several natural red flower heads above rich but moderately desaturated rounded scalloped leaves and delicate branching green stems. Top-right cell: a different compact soft rose-pink zonal geranium plant with rounded scalloped leaves and natural asymmetry. Bottom-left cell: a short hanging sprig of real small-leaved ivy, a few branching stems start near the top center and trail downward, irregular gaps between leaves, no flowers. Bottom-right cell: a loose natural bougainvillea sprig with small dusty magenta papery bracts, olive-green leaves, fine woody branches, irregular cascading silhouette. Each specimen is isolated entirely inside its own cell with at least 6 percent transparent padding on every side. Upright geraniums stand on a common baseline 90 percent down their cell; visible stems end there naturally, no pot, roots or soil; leaves and blooms occupy most of the cell. Front-facing botanical photography with orthographic-like perspective, all leaves and petals in sharp focus, microscopic veins and soft petal folds, realistic leaf-scale diversity, some curled and edge-on leaves, subtle imperfections and restrained natural colors. Neutral diffuse overcast illumination, soft local self-shading only, no strong directional highlights or baked cast shadow. True alpha cutout through the gaps between stems and leaves and around all silhouettes. Avoid a background of any kind, checkerboards, green rectangles, fringing, glow, outline, plastic or painted look, excessive flower density, perfect symmetry, butterflies, props, logos and watermarks.
pixel_edits: None; original RGBA output is preserved
